name: Aetheric Core
description: A pulsing Aether-cell that once powered an entire city. Mishandled, it could power your funeral instead.
effect: Powers Tartarian devices; potential mass-energy source; volatile.

name: Architect's Key
description: A small Tartarian relic that recognizes ancient locks. Doors that haven't opened in centuries swing for it.
effect: Unlocks Tartarian doors and dormant machines.

name: Tartarian Obelisk
description: A small Aether-emitting pillar that grants its bearer advantage on three uses per long rest. If damaged, it answers with a destructive Aether blast.
effect: Advantage on 3 actions per long rest; destruction = AoE Aether burst.

name: Void Compass
description: A compass that ignores magnetic north and points to whatever you most need to find. Or whatever most needs to find you.

name: Memory Prism
description: A crystal that holds the last few seconds of whatever last died near it. Hold it up to your eye.
effect: Replay psychic echo of a recent death; gain clue or lose Wisdom temporarily.

name: Resonance Lantern
description: A lamp that glows brighter in proximity to Aetherstone. Useless above ground.
effect: Reveals hidden Aetherstone caches within close range.

name: Temporal Lens
description: Look through it and see the city as it was in 1566 — for as long as your nerves hold.
effect: Shows pre-flood state of a location; sustained use causes 1d6 Corruption.

name: Aetheric Torch
description: An Aether-fueled light source. Will not extinguish in wind, rain, or fog.
effect: Reliable light; faintly attracts Aether-drawn creatures.

name: Aether-Binder Tool
description: A hand-tool used to shape Aetherstone, weld relic parts, or steady a malfunctioning core.
effect: Required for Mold Ether spell; +1 to crafting checks.

name: Aether-Breath Mask
description: A leather and brass mask with a small Aetherstone filter. Lets you breathe in storms and spore-clouds.

name: Aether Grip Pads
description: Palm-pads that grip Aetherstone and slick mud equally well.
effect: +2 to climbing and grip checks on slick surfaces.

name: Aetheric Vision Lens
description: A goggle-lens that reveals Aether currents and hidden Aetherstone signatures.
effect: Reveals hidden Aetheric phenomena, Aetherborn auras, dormant relics in line of sight.

name: Aetheric Locket
description: A small locket that hums when held close to a relic. Standard kit for Aetherborn children.
